name: Telegram Notification 0.4.3
description: Send finished videos to Telegram via MTProto (files over 50 MB and HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies supported). Posts the video only by default — no text at all; the text caption and the cover image each have their own switch. Can create/reuse one group forum topic per model and post the video into it. Uses your signed-in account by default: it can list existing topics (no duplicates) and premium accounts can upload single files up to 4 GB

account.label: Login mode (auto = your signed-in account wins / user = your account only / bot = bot account only)

api_hash.label: API Hash (bot accounts only — leave empty for a user account)

chat_id.label: Chat ID (groups and supergroups: -100xxxxxxxxxx; a private group has no username, so the id is the only way to target it)

username.label: Group username (optional — public groups only, e.g. mygroupname, without @; leave empty for private groups and use Chat ID)

send_caption.label: Attach a text caption (model name, timestamp, duration, file name, size). With this off the message carries no text at all — just the video

send_cover.label: Also send the cover image (contact-sheet preview). With this off the album holds the video only

topic_per_model.label: Create/reuse a group topic per model and upload into it

delete_after_send.label: Delete local data after a successful send (video, segments, metadata and module side files) to free server space

upload_workers.label: Concurrent upload parts (default 8, max 16; 0 = default). Serial uploads wait for the server to acknowledge every 512KB part; running several at once overlaps those round trips — a 12MB video measured ~1.8x faster (the uplink itself is the ceiling)
